audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 phase text says your Q-poke wins level 1 while the side is Darius — the page contradicts itself.
audit.why: Darius's Decimate outer blade heals him and Hemorrhage stacks off every hit; Malphite has only Seismic Shard at 625 range and loses any melee exchange.
audit.corrected: Level 1 rewritten to state Darius owns it and why, with the 625 range last-hit instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item phase is generic Iceborn Gauntlet boilerplate with no reason attached.
audit.why: Darius is a pure-AD kit apart from Noxian Guillotine's true damage, so the armour item plus Ground Slam's attack-speed cut is the actual spike.
audit.corrected: First-item phase now names the AD profile as the reason the lane flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: Never states that Ground Slam's attack-speed reduction slows Hemorrhage stacking and Crippling Strike, and never states that Noxian Guillotine is true damage and ignores the armour you build.
audit.why: Hemorrhage stacks on attacks and damaging abilities; Crippling Strike is an auto-attack reset. Cutting attack speed cuts both. Guillotine deals true damage, so armour does not reduce the execute.
audit.corrected: Added Ground Slam attack-speed interaction and the true-damage caveat on his ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice; Apprehend is described but never numbered.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 falling to 16s at rank 5 — the single longest punish window in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Apprehend's real cooldown added to the cooldown breakdown, the Levels 4-5 phase and the first Do.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Darius contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Decimate's outer blade heals him off you while Hemorrhage ticks and you have only Seismic Shard (Q). Last-hit from 625 range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Apprehend's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 — the moment he burns it on the wave, walk up, Ground Slam his attack speed, and reset behind the shield.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Apprehend's cooldown.
edits.after: Your first armour item flips it — he is pure AD, so Ground Slam plus stacked armour guts him.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Q-kite after it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Darius Apprehend (E): 26s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — his only gap-close, so step up the instant it misses. - Your Ground Slam: 7s flat, spend it on his Crippling Strike auto. - Unstoppable Force: 130s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Darius's Apprehend (Pull): His all-in start. Q-kite after it. When it is down — R-W-E him.
edits.after: Ground Slam (E, 7s) cuts his attack speed, so Hemorrhage stacks slower and Crippling Strike lands softer.

edits.before: His all-in start. Q-kite after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His only gap-close, 26s at rank 1. Step up the moment it misses, not before.

edits.before: Your R (Unstoppable Force) cancels his Apprehend and knocks him up, but his Noxian Guillotine still executes at high bleed stacks — gauge his Hemorrhage before you commit.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force knocks him up and interrupts the Decimate wind-up, but Noxian Guillotine is true damage — armour will not save you, so count his Hemorrhage stacks before you commit.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force finally gives you a way to flip the lane — R cancels his E reposition and your knock-up beats his Apprehend setup, but his R execute still punishes a bad gauge of his bleed stacks.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force flips the lane — the knock-up interrupts his Decimate wind-up and beats his Apprehend step-up, but Noxian Guillotine is true damage and still executes through your armour at high bleed.
